config.scope: Matched C-compiled freestanding ELF execution; native outputs checked independently; failures retained.

methodology.artifact_bytes: Selector artifact_bytes counts its JSON export; direct-effect artifact_bytes counts model.pt only, excluding companion config/result JSON. Formats and scopes differ; not total deployment size.
methodology.cold: Runner ENTERED timestamp (after standard-library imports) to first completed response, including Torch/runtime imports, artifact parsing/load, snapshot/export/GC, and first request. Excludes interpreter startup and earlier standard-library imports. Never called time to first token.
methodology.dynamic_count: Separate ptrace single-step run; not timed as native performance. Counts can treat REP iterations as multiple traps. Incomplete traces are not full-program instruction counts.
methodology.failures: Refusal, faults, wrong output, timeouts, missing cells, and instrument errors remain observations. Their time to stop is diagnostic, not successful execution performance or a speedup.
methodology.load: Median of per-cell instrumented load regions; selector JSON parse is separate, checkpoint deserialization is inside direct-effect load. Load regions may include lazy imports.
methodology.memory: Usage field names ending _mb are MiB. Request RSS is sampled whole-process RSS, includes Python/Torch, and is not weight bytes or an exact allocation peak. Native RSS is wait4 child maximum and may be unavailable for very short programs.
methodology.native: All requested native repeats must match exact stdout and exit. Fork/exec through wait4 wall time, excluding parent pipe capture/file writes.
methodology.requests: Instrumented runner scope includes ELF/process initialization and execution, supplied ABI, and Usage sampler overhead; not pure model-forward time.
methodology.successful_warm: All requested warm repeats must be present, observable-exact, from a completed cell with unchanged artifact. No first request or failed sample enters the warm median.
